common.description: Common UI strings shared across the Sahaj Atlas app — labels, loading states, and map filter toggles.

events.description: Generic plural noun for meditation events, used in counts and labels (e.g. "3 events").

free_meditation_class.description: Singular label for a free meditation class; used in headings and map markers.

free_meditation_classes.description: Plural label for free meditation classes; used in page headings and section titles.

language_selector.description: Accessible label (aria-label) for the language-picker dropdown in the navbar.

loading.description: Generic loading indicator shown while content is being fetched.

show_online_classes.description: Map filter toggle label (off state) — invites the user to include online-only classes.

showing_online_classes.description: Map filter toggle label (on state) — indicates online classes are currently shown.

region.description: Copy for region, location, and venue landing pages.

locations.description: Headings and result-count lines on a location/region landing page.

title.description: Heading on a location/region landing page. `%{location}` = region or place name.

description_one.description: Singular result-count line under a location heading. `%{count}` = 1, `%{location}` = region name.

description_other.description: Plural result-count line under a location heading. `%{count}` = number, `%{location}` = region name.

venues.description: Headings and result-count lines on a venue landing page.

title.description: Heading on a venue landing page. `%{venue}` = venue name.

description_one.description: Singular result-count line under a venue heading. `%{count}` = 1, `%{venue}` = venue name.

description_other.description: Plural result-count line under a venue heading. `%{count}` = number, `%{venue}` = venue name.

event.description: Copy for event details, recurrence schedules, and timezone conversion.

details.description: Labels and actions shown on an event's detail view (directions, contact, distance, online badges).

contact_for_timing.description: Shown instead of a schedule when an event has no fixed time; prompts the user to contact the host.

contact_host.description: Label/action to contact the event host.

get_directions.description: Button that opens map directions to the event venue.

hosted_from.description: Host-location label for an online event. `%{city}` = host city.

km.description: Distance-unit suffix (kilometres) shown next to an event's distance from the user.

more_info.description: Link/button to expand or open fuller event details.

online.description: Short badge indicating an online event.

online_class.description: Fuller label for an online class.

starting_on.description: Event start-date label. `%{date}` = formatted start date.

starting_soon.description: Label for an event whose start is imminent.

tel.description: Telephone-link label for the host's number. `%{phoneNumber}` = phone number.

view_photo.description: Button/link that opens the event's photo in the lightbox.

recurrence.description: Human-readable recurrence labels. Rendered via t('recurrence.<type>', { weekday }). English uses the simple weekly/monthly forms; other locales use the detailed weekly_1/2 + monthly_* forms. `%{weekday}` = localized day name.

daily.description: Recurrence label for an event that repeats every day.

weekly.description: Weekly recurrence, simple form (English). `%{weekday}` = day name.

weekly_1.description: Weekly recurrence, every week — detailed form used by non-English locales. `%{weekday}` = day name.

weekly_2.description: Weekly recurrence, every second week. `%{weekday}` = day name.

monthly_1st.description: Monthly recurrence on the 1st given weekday of the month. `%{weekday}` = day name.

monthly_2nd.description: Monthly recurrence on the 2nd given weekday of the month. `%{weekday}` = day name.

monthly_3rd.description: Monthly recurrence on the 3rd given weekday of the month. `%{weekday}` = day name.

monthly_4th.description: Monthly recurrence on the 4th given weekday of the month. `%{weekday}` = day name.

monthly_last.description: Monthly recurrence on the last given weekday of the month. `%{weekday}` = day name.

no_recurrence.description: Fallback when an event has no fixed schedule (formerly the `null` key).

timing.description: Copy for event timing and timezone conversion.

converted_to.description: Tooltip shown when an event time is converted to the viewer's timezone. `%{timezone}` = tz name, `%{offset}` = UTC offset.

title.description: Auto-generated event titles. Used when a manager leaves an event's title blank — preferred over a hand-written generic name, because these localize and can be improved centrally. One complete sentence per time of day (not a shared prefix plus a separate word), so each locale can put the time of day wherever its grammar needs it. `%{place}` = the first comma-segment of the street address.

morning.description: Auto-title for an event starting between 05:00 and 11:59 local time. `%{place}` = venue or street.

afternoon.description: Auto-title for an event starting between 12:00 and 16:59 local time. `%{place}` = venue or street.

evening.description: Auto-title for an event starting between 17:00 and 21:59 local time. `%{place}` = venue or street.

default.description: Auto-title used when the start time is late (22:00–04:59) or the event has no schedule at all. `%{place}` = venue or street.

registration.description: Copy for the event registration form — fields, validation errors, and optional questions.

form.description: Labels, placeholders, notices, and CTAs in the registration form/modal.

cancel.description: Cancel button in the registration form/modal.

invite_friend.description: Option encouraging the user to bring a guest.

mailing_list_consent.description: Consent checkbox label for the events mailing list.

okay.description: Acknowledgement button (e.g. dismisses the thank-you state).

online_notice.description: Notice for online classes explaining the join link is emailed.

privacy_policy.description: Consent/disclaimer text shown near the submit button.

register_now.description: Primary CTA to open the registration form.

submit.description: Submit button for the registration form.

thank_you.description: Success message shown after a successful registration.

errors.description: Validation error messages for the registration form fields.

email.description: Validation error for an invalid/empty email field.

name.description: Validation error for an empty/invalid name field.

starting_at.description: Validation error when no starting date is chosen.

questions.description: Optional registration questions, rendered via t('questions.<key>'); the set shown per event varies.

accessibility.description: Optional registration question about accessibility needs.

aspirations.description: Optional registration question about the attendee's goals.

experience.description: Optional registration question about prior experience with this meditation.

guests.description: Optional registration question about accompanying guests.

health_info.description: Optional registration question about relevant health information (renamed from `healthInfo`).

prior_experience.description: Optional registration question about prior Sahaja Yoga practice (renamed from `priorExperience`).

questions.description: Optional registration question inviting free-form questions.

referral.description: Optional registration question about how the attendee found the organisation.

referral_source.description: Optional registration question about how the attendee found this specific event (renamed from `referralSource`).

share.description: Copy for the event share action.

action.description: Label for the share action/button on an event; seeds the forthcoming Share view (renamed from `details.share`).

emails.description: Chrome for the emails the CMS sends: the confirmations and reminders seekers receive in the language they registered in, and the `verify_*` event-verification reminders managers receive in their own language. Event data (title, address, times, durations) is never translated — only the surrounding copy is.

confirmation_subject.description: Subject line of the registration confirmation email. `%{event}` = event title.

confirmation_heading.description: Main heading inside the confirmation email, e.g. "You're registered".

confirmation_intro.description: Opening line addressing the registrant. `%{name}` = registrant's name.

when_label.description: Section label above the date/time of the class.

where_label.description: Section label above the address or joining link.

online_cta.description: Call-to-action button label for joining an online class.

online_link_hint.description: Line introducing the plain-text join URL, shown for email clients that strip buttons.

directions_cta.description: Call-to-action button label that opens the venue address in a maps app, for an in-person class.

about_label.description: Section label above the event description ("What to expect").

contact_label.description: Section label above the host's name and phone number.

sessions_count.description: Session count appended to a limited-run course's schedule, entered per plural form. `%{count}` = number of sessions.

footer_reason.description: Footer line explaining why the registrant received this email.

footer_website.description: Footer link label pointing at the client service's website. `%{name}` = service name.

reminder_subject.description: Subject line of the session reminder email (sent 24h before a class). `%{event}` = event title.

reminder_heading.description: Main heading inside the reminder email, e.g. "Your class is tomorrow".

reminder_intro.description: Opening line of the reminder email. `%{name}` = registrant's name.

reminder_footer_reason.description: Footer line explaining why the registrant received the reminder.

unsubscribe_cta.description: Footer link label in the reminder email that opens the unsubscribe page.

unsubscribe_heading.description: Heading on the unsubscribe landing page.

unsubscribe_intro.description: Prompt on the unsubscribe page confirming what stops. `%{event}` = event title.

unsubscribe_confirm_cta.description: Button label that confirms unsubscribing from reminders.

unsubscribe_working.description: Button label shown while the unsubscribe request is in flight.

unsubscribe_done_title.description: Title of the success card after unsubscribing.

unsubscribe_done_message.description: Body of the success card after unsubscribing.

unsubscribe_error_title.description: Title of the error card when unsubscribing fails.

unsubscribe_error_message.description: Body of the error card when unsubscribing fails.

verify_greeting.description: Opening line of the event-verification reminder sent to managers. `%{name}` = the manager's name (shown in bold).

verify_button_hint.description: Line introducing the plain-text verify URL, shown for email clients that strip buttons.

verify_footer_manager.description: Footer of the reminder sent to the event's own manager, explaining why they received it and warning against forwarding. `%{brand}` = product name.

verify_footer_region.description: Same footer, for a region manager escalated to above the event manager. `%{brand}` = product name.

verify_contact_subject.description: Subject of the pre-filled email a region manager's "Contact manager" button opens. `%{event}` = event title.

verify_contact_body.description: Body of that pre-filled email, asking the event manager to verify. `%{manager}` = their name, `%{event}` = event title. Line breaks are preserved.

verify_manager_heading.description: Section heading above the event manager's contact card (region reminders only).

verify_details_heading.description: Section heading above the event's summary table.

verify_label_name.description: Row label for the event manager's name.

verify_label_event.description: Row label for the event's title.

verify_label_online.description: Row label for an online event's joining link (replaces the address label).

verify_label_address.description: Row label for an in-person event's address.

verify_label_schedule.description: Row label for the event's schedule. The schedule itself is a formatted date/time and stays untranslated.

verify_label_breaks.description: Row label for the event's scheduled breaks (holiday pauses).

verify_label_contact.description: Row label for the event's public contact name and phone.

verify_label_registrations.description: Row label for how many people registered recently.

verify_label_last_verified.description: Row label for the date the event was last verified.

verify_never_verified.description: Value shown in the last-verified row when the event has never been verified.

verify_view_event_cta.description: Secondary button label opening the event's public page on the map.

verify_registrations_count.description: Recent-registration count shown in the summary table, entered per plural form. `%{count}` = number of registrations in the last 30 days.

verify_fallback_manager.description: Stand-in used in place of the event manager's name when it is unknown, e.g. "the event manager".

verify_fallback_region.description: Stand-in used in place of the region's name when it is unknown, e.g. "your region".

verify_fallback_deadline.description: Stand-in used in place of the unpublish date when it is unknown, e.g. "shortly".

verify_manager_due_subject.description: Subject of the first verification reminder to the event manager. `%{event}` = event title.

verify_manager_due_heading.description: Heading of the first reminder to the event manager.

verify_manager_due_preview.description: Inbox preview snippet of the first reminder to the event manager.

verify_manager_due_cta.description: Verify-button label on the first reminder to the event manager.

verify_manager_due_body.description: Main paragraph of the first reminder: why events are checked periodically. `%{brand}` = product name.

verify_manager_due_callout.description: Highlighted instruction on the first reminder. `%{deadline}` = the date the event is unpublished (shown in bold).

verify_manager_escalated_subject.description: Subject of the overdue reminder to the event manager. `%{event}` = event title.

verify_manager_escalated_heading.description: Heading of the overdue reminder to the event manager.

verify_manager_escalated_preview.description: Inbox preview snippet of the overdue reminder to the event manager.

verify_manager_escalated_cta.description: Verify-button label on the overdue reminder to the event manager.

verify_manager_escalated_body.description: Main paragraph of the overdue reminder to the event manager.

verify_manager_escalated_callout.description: Highlighted instruction on the overdue reminder. `%{deadline}` = the date the event is unpublished (shown in bold).

verify_manager_urgent_subject.description: Subject of the final reminder to the event manager. `%{event}` = event title.

verify_manager_urgent_heading.description: Heading of the final reminder to the event manager.

verify_manager_urgent_preview.description: Inbox preview snippet of the final reminder to the event manager.

verify_manager_urgent_cta.description: Verify-button label on the final reminder to the event manager.

verify_manager_urgent_body.description: Main paragraph of the final reminder to the event manager.

verify_manager_urgent_callout.description: Highlighted instruction on the final reminder. `%{deadline}` = the date the event is unpublished (shown in bold).

verify_manager_expired_subject.description: Subject of the notice telling the event manager their event was unpublished. `%{event}` = event title.

verify_manager_expired_heading.description: Heading of the unpublished notice to the event manager.

verify_manager_expired_preview.description: Inbox preview snippet of the unpublished notice to the event manager.

verify_manager_expired_cta.description: Verify-button label on the unpublished notice — verifying republishes the event.

verify_manager_expired_body.description: Main paragraph of the unpublished notice. `%{since}` = how long the event went unverified (a formatted duration, e.g. "3 months").

verify_manager_expired_callout.description: Highlighted instruction on the unpublished notice. `%{deadline}` = the date the event was unpublished (shown in bold).

verify_region_escalated_subject.description: Subject of the first escalation to a region manager. `%{event}` = event title.

verify_region_escalated_heading.description: Heading of the first escalation to a region manager.

verify_region_escalated_preview.description: Inbox preview snippet of the first escalation to a region manager.

verify_region_escalated_cta.description: Button label that opens a pre-filled email to the event manager.

verify_region_escalated_body.description: Main paragraph asking the region manager to chase the event manager. `%{region}` = region name, `%{manager}` = event manager's name (both shown in bold).

verify_region_escalated_callout.description: Highlighted instruction on the first escalation. `%{deadline}` = the date the event is unpublished (shown in bold).

verify_region_urgent_subject.description: Subject of the final escalation to a region manager. `%{event}` = event title.

verify_region_urgent_heading.description: Heading of the final escalation to a region manager.

verify_region_urgent_preview.description: Inbox preview snippet of the final escalation to a region manager.

verify_region_urgent_cta.description: Button label that opens a pre-filled email to the event manager.

verify_region_urgent_body.description: Main paragraph of the final escalation. `%{region}` = region name, `%{manager}` = event manager's name (both shown in bold).

verify_region_urgent_callout.description: Highlighted instruction on the final escalation. `%{deadline}` = the date the event is unpublished (shown in bold).

verify_region_expired_subject.description: Subject of the notice telling a region manager an event in their region was unpublished. `%{event}` = event title.

verify_region_expired_heading.description: Heading of the unpublished notice to a region manager.

verify_region_expired_preview.description: Inbox preview snippet of the unpublished notice to a region manager.

verify_region_expired_cta.description: Button label that opens a pre-filled email to the event manager.

verify_region_expired_body.description: Main paragraph of the unpublished notice to a region manager. `%{region}` = region name, `%{manager}` = event manager's name (both shown in bold), `%{since}` = how long it went unverified (a formatted duration, e.g. "3 months").

verify_region_expired_callout.description: Highlighted instruction on the unpublished notice. `%{deadline}` = the date the event was unpublished (shown in bold).
